field_definition: Observer compares selected program identities against the recorded round882reference; candidate is pre-decision, retained is post-decision; counts use91ordereddevelopmentcontexts. Changes may reflect both adapter and candidate-pool variation.
source_binding: Observer script hash and reference receipt metadata checked; installed loop source/adapter/population/normalization closure remains unqualified
scope: Adaptive repeatedly used development population; no independent first-proposal, deployment, transfer or learned writer/value-net benefit inferred

claims: Changed evaluation identity, mismatched selection/context counts and duplicate context IDs are refused.
Candidate and post-decision retained program IDs are compared with the stored reference, not with their utilities.
Unrounded finite utility is compared with retained utility; ties are accepted by default.
Accepted ties can update the recorded best-round identity without a strict score gain.
